title: AC1027 standalone ENTITIES WIPEOUT LTYPE XDATA target binding

scope.source: Runtime-generated original ASCII and binary DXF records; no repository drawing fixture was added.
scope.cross_product: One model-space ENTITIES WIPEOUT code-1005 target across all four source/output encoding pairs.

xdata.provider: source-bound simple LTYPE EditDash and APPID MLINE_LTYPE_XDATA

proof.source: The target index now admits the WIPEOUT parser callback only for an exact DRW_Wipeout dynamic type with a valid clip boundary, after matching the physical ENTITIES span, handle, owner, typed callback and live target identity.
proof.output: All four ASCII/binary input/output combinations verify remapped WIPEOUT identity, ENTITIES section and model-space owner; AcDbWipeout subclass, base/secondary points, pixel vector and size, clip-boundary type, ordered polygon vertices and clip mode; and fresh typed WIPEOUT/LTYPE readback.
proof.failure_retry: Each encoding pair removes the target and verifies destination preservation followed by same-adapter retry. A late handle mutation also refuses with destination preservation and succeeds after restoring target identity.

limits: This qualifies one AC1027 model-space ENTITIES WIPEOUT profile. Named-BLOCKS WIPEOUT, other WIPEOUT field/version profiles and multiple-target combinations remain unqualified.
The selected transport proof does not establish rendered mask appearance, broader raster/image relationships, complete-document conversion or independent CAD semantics.
P2 remains open for other code-1005 target types, mixed target sets and broader source/output profiles.
next: Select the next P2 target only after reproducing a concrete code-1005 parser, source-binding or emitted-output gap; prefer an existing callback type with a bounded independent semantic profile and avoid unqualified type or section expansion.
